d:
Jammu-kashmir ke rahne vale qazi tauqir, in dinon riyliti sho 'big bos' men hain. qazi tauqir ko lagbhag 20 sal pahle ek singing tailent sho jitne ke bad pahli bar shohrat mili thi. tab unki us kamyabi par kashmir men kaphi jashn manaya gaya tha. kashmir men kala, sangit aur manoranjan se juri gatividhiyon ke lie hamesha se hi simit avsar rahe hain, aise men qazi tauqir ka big bos jaise rieliti sho men apni maujudgi darj karvana aam kashmiriyon ke lie kitna mayne rakhta hai?
Riport: kaisar andrabi
Shut aur edit shafat faruq
